title: Trump’s PH arrival pushed back to Nov. 18–19 — envoy
summary: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump is now expected to arrive in the Philippines on Nov. 18 to 19, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel “Babe” Romualdez said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump is now expected to arrive in the Philippines on Nov. 18 to 19, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel “Babe” Romualdez said on Saturday. “So far yes,” Romualdez told the Inquirer when asked whether the American leader was expected to visit Manila on those dates.
